# Implementation Plan: Native-codex inject endpoint — daemon-owned, hook-free crews shrink

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph` on 2026-06-28. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan <job_dir>/plan.md`.*

## Overview

Today crews coordination is a Node-hook layer (`pre-tool-use`, `post-tool-use`, `stop`, `session-start`) bolted onto native `& codex` tabs. The hooks are load-bearing AND fragile: they enforce listener-arm, kind-tag, review-required, and crash-sweep through file locks that suffer EPERM/`LockTimeout` races (e.g. `liveness-notifications.json.lock`, `manifest.json.lock`), and a Stop hook hard-vetoes turn-end to force the agent to read mail. The operator's goal is a codex-only crew with **zero crews `.codex-plugin` Node hooks AND zero rehost**: members stay NATIVE `& codex` tabs.

The decisive enabler (round-4 brainstorm `@26becdba`, D-001): a single happy-cli daemon **injects** mail (RUNNING ⇒ steer, IDLE ⇒ wake) into native codex members, **sole-owns** mailbox/cursor/review/crash files (killing the locks), and reads each member's **AppServerEvent stream** for kind-tag/identity/crash (NOT stdout scraping). All crews hooks are dropped; the soft gate is acceptable because *inject IS the read* — no Stop veto needed.

**Phase-4 feasibility correction (US-000 gate decides the seam — do not assume the thin overlay).** The brainstorm's "thin overlay listener wrapping the inject primitives + ≤3 line tui seam" framing is partly wrong and is the FIRST thing US-000 must settle: (1) `try_start_turn_if_idle` / `inject_no_new_turn` are `pub(crate)` and `Session` is crate-private — only `inject_if_running` is `pub`, so a separate overlay crate cannot reach the wake half; (2) the `tui/src/app.rs` seam holds an `AppServerSession` *client*, not `Arc<Session>`, and only fans events outbound — no inbound inject path exists there. HOWEVER, the daemon already speaks app-server over loopback ws, and the app-server already exposes **`thread/inject_items` + `turn/steer`** requests, and `CodexThread` exposes **pub** `inject_if_running`/`try_start_turn_if_idle` wrappers. So the likely cheapest path is **reuse the existing app-server command surface (near-zero/zero codex patch)**, not a new overlay listener. US-000 picks: (a) reuse app-server `thread/inject_items`+`turn/steer`; (b) expose a `pub` wake wrapper; (c) new overlay listener. This may shrink the codex work to ~0 and make it mostly a happy-cli daemon job — or fall back to D-003.

Substrate ~80% exists in `packages/happy-cli/src/agentComms/` and the daemon control server. The net-new is: one overlay listener + one bounded TUI seam (codex), a daemon inject route + sole-writer mailbox + event-stream reader (happy-cli), and hook deletion (crews). Fallback **D-003** (file-ownership-only, KEEP hooks) is the cheaper retreat if the codex patch / daemon-SPOF cost is not worth zero-hooks. Pilot validates ONE ralph in-session fan-out site.

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context
**Codex inject substrate (all present, in-process today):**
- `codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/core/src/session/inject.rs:19-35` — `inject_if_running(&self, input: Vec<ResponseItem>) -> Result<(), Vec<ResponseItem>>`; needs only `&self`, injects into an active turn else returns items (RUNNING/steer).
- `inject.rs:45-129` — `try_start_turn_if_idle(self: &Arc<Self>, input) -> Result<(), TryStartTurnIfIdleError>`; idle-wake, requires `Arc<Self>`, reserves an idle turn and starts a `RegularTask`.
- `core/src/tasks/mod.rs:575-613` — `maybe_start_turn_for_pending_work(self: &Arc<Self>)` idle-wake helper triggered when mailbox `trigger_turn` exists.
- `core/src/session/input_queue.rs:96-117` — `enqueue_mailbox_communication(&self, communication: InterAgentCommunication)`; `trigger_turn` is a checked field (`has_trigger_turn_mailbox_items()`).
- `tui/src/app.rs:1034,1243` — bounded outbound seam: TUI clones `AppServerEvent` into `happy_tap` gated by `Feature::RemoteSession`. **Outbound only; no `Arc<Session>` here (holds `AppServerSession`).**
- Reuse path (preferred): `CodexThread::inject_if_running` (codex_thread.rs:298, pub) + `try_start_turn_if_idle` (:318, pub); app-server `thread/inject_items` (`app_server_session.rs:732`, `ThreadInjectItemsParams`) + `TurnSteer` (:107-108) — already public command surface the daemon's loopback ws can drive.
- `features/src/lib.rs:173-177` — `RemoteSession` default-off; add `LoopbackInject` only IF US-000 picks option (b)/(c).

**Overlay (fork-owned) consumer:** `codex/codex-rs-overlay/codex-happy/src/{lib.rs:1-18, attach.rs:458-499, mapping.rs:52-88, inbound.rs:111-135}` — attach requires `~/.happy` + `SessionClient` (NOT reusable hook-free); `AppServerEvent` `TurnStarted`/`TurnCompleted` give turn boundaries, `ItemStarted`/`ItemCompleted` give item tags — the event stream is the protocol source, not stdout.

**happy-cli daemon substrate (~80% shipped):** `packages/happy-cli/src/agentComms/{mailbox,router,recovery,ingestHandler,peer*,spawnApproval}.ts`; daemon entrypoint `daemon/run.ts` (`startDaemon()`), control server Fastify on `127.0.0.1` with `POST /agent-comms/send` (`daemon/controlServer.ts:66,291-292,391`). Mailbox is durable: cursor + `pending[]` in `mailbox.json`, `history.jsonl` audit, today gated by cross-process `mailbox.lock` because there are TWO writers (daemon + consumer bridge) — F-007. Sole-writer daemon removes the second writer ⇒ kills the lock.

**crews hooks to drop:** `ai-developer-toolkit/plugins/crews/hooks/{pre-tool-use,post-tool-use,stop,session-start}.js` + `lib/listener-protocol.js` + `actors.js:306-488` (native `& codex` tab spawn via `wt.exe`). They enforce listener-arm, kind-tag, review-required nag, crash sweep — all become soft under daemon-injection.

### Technical Constraints
- Inject primitives are **in-process** (need `Arc<Session>`); the only inbound driver reaching them remotely (`attach.rs`) hard-requires happy-server + `Feature::RemoteSession`. So no-rehost-no-happy-server = a NEW local-IPC inject endpoint, not free reuse. SMALL but real upstream-touching patch.
- TUI stdout is ANSI-redraw + title-suppressed + sandbox-exit-prone with no turn boundary; protocol MUST come from `AppServerEvent`.
- Daemon SPOF: one crash freezes every member's un-injected mail (mitigated by durable mailbox re-read on restart). Codex-only mono-engine: Claude/Copilot members have no inject seam.

## Approach

### Architecture
- **codex overlay:** new default-off `Feature::LoopbackInject`; an overlay-only loopback listener (named pipe Windows / UDS POSIX) that decodes a tiny `{mode:"steer"|"wake", text}` frame to `Vec<ResponseItem>` and calls `inject_if_running` (steer) or `try_start_turn_if_idle` (wake). Start/stop wired from the `tui/src/app.rs:1236-1246` seam, transport kept out of `tui`.
- **happy-cli daemon:** new control route `POST /agent-comms/inject` resolves member endpoint and injects; daemon becomes SOLE mailbox writer (consumer never writes ⇒ drop `mailbox.lock`); daemon reads each member's AppServerEvent stream for kind-tag/identity/crash.
- **crews:** delete the four Node hooks + listener loop; member spawn stays native tab; coordination becomes daemon-driven; soft gate.

### Implementation Strategy (3 repos — see Multi-repo split)
0. **US-000 spike (gate):** prove app-server `thread/inject_items`+`turn/steer` reuse vs core wake-wrapper vs overlay; GO/NO-GO vs D-003.
1. **A. codex submodule:** ONLY if reuse insufficient — `pub` wake wrapper / overlay + Windows auth (US-001).
2. **B. happy-cli:** inject client + event-reader/identity + sole-writer/ack + SPOF (US-002..US-005).
3. **C. crews:** drop all 5 hooks behind a flag; pilot ONE fan-out (US-006, US-007).

### Files to Create/Modify
- codex (only if US-000=b/c): `features/src/lib.rs` (+`LoopbackInject`), `pub` wake wrapper at the Session/CodexThread layer (NOT tui), `docs/implementation/patch-surface.md` (invariant). Worktree: `codex/.worktrees/<task>`. Prefer ZERO codex edit (drive `thread/inject_items`+`turn/steer`).
- happy-cli: `src/daemon/controlServer.ts` (route), `src/agentComms/mailbox.ts` (sole-writer + ack states), new `src/agentComms/injectClient.ts` + `eventReader.ts`, `daemon/run.ts` wiring.
- crews: delete `hooks/{pre,post,stop,session-start,codex-user-prompt-submit}.js` + `lib/listener-protocol.js`; keep `actors.js` spawn; flag-gate `CREWS_DAEMON_INJECT`.

## Scope
### In Scope
- Daemon injects RUNNING=steer/IDLE=wake via app-server reuse (preferred) or minimal gated codex wake; authed local endpoint.
- Daemon sole-owns consume+cursor+review+crash (kills EPERM/LockTimeout) AFTER writer inventory; pending→injected→observed ack; kind-tag/identity/crash from AppServerEvent.
- Drop all 5 crews hooks; codex-only; soft gate; pilot ONE fan-out.
### Out of Scope
- Rehost into happy-cli runCodex. Hard turn-veto. TUI-stdout scraping. Cross-engine members. Central happy-server. Mid-turn preemption.

## Risk Areas
- **Feasibility/seam (US-000, BLOCKING gate):** private wake primitive + tui has no `Arc<Session>` ⇒ "≤3-line overlay" thesis is false. Spike app-server `thread/inject_items`+`turn/steer` reuse FIRST; only patch core if reuse can't idle-wake. Resolve before any other story.
- **Sole-writer:** drop locks ONLY after writer inventory (consumer bridge `agentCommsBridge.ts:133`, ingest `controlServer.ts:354`, crews stop/review-mail/session-start/crash-sweep) all behind daemon APIs — premature lock-drop = races.
- **Ack semantics:** "inject IS read" must not mark consumed on injection; use pending→injected→observed (AppServerEvent evidence) + idempotency keys, else loss/dup.
- **Windows transport:** named-pipe ACL + capability-token auth for the local inject endpoint (mirror codex ws-auth); unplanned ⇒ unauth local injection.
- **Build/dist:** native tabs must run the patched binary if any core change ships. **SPOF + mono-engine:** durable mailbox; documented. **D-003 retreat** if patch/SPOF > zero-hook value.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Native member receives daemon-injected mail RUNNING (steer) + IDLE (wake) with NO happy-server, ZERO crews hooks, ZERO EPERM/LockTimeout; kind-tag/identity/crash from AppServerEvent; daemon-SPOF recovery; overlay-mostly patch < rehost; pilot ONE fan-out green.
